newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Skanska says wins half of 1.9 bln Skr Russia order.
newsitem.headline: Skanska says wins half of 1.9 bln Skr Russia order.

text.p: Swedish construction group Skanska said on Thursday its Finnish subsidiary Skanska Oy in 50/50 cooperation with British Taylor Woodrow Plc won a 1.9 billion crown order in Russia.
The companies will build a new commercial centre in St Petersburg, Skanska said in a statement.
"The new 150,000 square meter transportation and commercial centre is the first step towards the establishment of a new express railway service linking St. Petersburg with Moscow," the company said.
"In addition to the terminal, the project includes a new three-star hotel, offices, residences and parking facilities."
The companies won the order from Russia's High Speed Railway Shareholding Company, Skanska said, adding that financial support was expected from Britain's Export Credit Guarantee Department.
Work on the project will begin as soon as the financial agreements are completed, it said.
